verdict.summary: The extraction is coherent and preserves the existing feature-gated public surfaces through re-exports. The new leaf has no shipping dependencies (parser dependencies are dev-only), all three consumers enable it only through their existing default-off features, and the relocated parsed-Turtle tests plus consumer-specific registry guards exercise the real vocabulary and annotation paths. The ZK honesty caveats remain explicit and consistent with sq-qhy4; no unqualified privacy or soundness claim is introduced. The reverse-dependency test-selection updates match the new Cargo edges, and the removed cross-package include_str! guards are replaced rather than silently lost.
